name: Vector 4Seasons (tube type)

origin.basis: Goodyear's bicycle-tire line was developed with Rubber Kinetics by a team at Goodyear's Akron, Ohio headquarters (Bicycle Retailer, 2018).

manufacturing.basis: Goodyear does not state where these tires are made.

positioning: Tube-type version of the four-season Vector with an armoured 120 TPI casing.
weight_basis: Goodyear store weights for this construction.

wet_notes.summary: Goodyear names it a four-season tire; the store page gives no specific wet-grip claim or test.

availability.note: Sold by Goodyear Bicycle Tires' US-dollar web store; mainland China and European availability not verified for this model.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; US shipping and tax at checkout.

caveats: No independent wet-grip test found; the four-season label is the maker positioning.

image.shown: Goodyear's cutaway render of the tube-type Vector 4Seasons; one render covers every width.
image.alt: Goodyear Vector 4Seasons tube-type road tire render with a cutaway showing the casing and protection layer
